feedback.problem:
|  | $Y=0$ | $Y=1$ | $Y=2$ | $Y=4$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $X=0$ | $0.1$ | $0.01$ | $0.04$ | $0.2$ |
| $X=1$ | $0.04$ | $0.1$ | $0.2$ | $0.04$ |
| $X=2$ | $0.02$ | $0.04$ | $0.01$ | $0.2$ |

Calculate $P(Y=2X)$ given that the random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above.
feedback.worked_solution:
Using the values in the table, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(Y=2X) & =P(X=0,Y=0)+P(X=1,Y=2)+P(X=2,Y=4) \\  & =f(0,0)+f(1,2)+f(2,4) \\  & =0.1+0.2+0.2 \\  & =0.5.\end{aligned}
$$
